routing_contract.when_to_use: Use when preparing WHO to email before any send is designed: segmenting an exported list/CRM/GA4/ecommerce export into behavioral segments (engaged-90d, cart-abandoners), RFM tiers, and lifecycle stages (new, active, lapsed, win-back), and building the suppression list (unsubscribed, hard-bounced, spam-complained, consent-withdrawn) by reading the consent-registry as the source of truth for consent and suppression facts.
